battle.name: 穆斯林征服河中地區
battle.theater: 河中：阿姆河與錫爾河之間
battle.brief: 673年秋，烏拜德·阿倫·齊亞德接任呼羅珊總督，翌春渡阿姆河攻布哈拉，迫其繳百萬銀迪拉姆；此役拉成數十年征戰，終以751年怛羅斯之役收尾。卡面羅馬短劍標示短刺兵刃的老底子：東羅馬的近身裝備經敘利亞線流入新軍，盾緣與刺突節奏仍留在攻城與巷戰的骨子裡。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 河中，阿拉伯語作 Mā warāʾ al-nahr，義為「河那邊的土地」，是阿姆河與錫爾河之間的綠洲帶，粟特人的城邦群落所在。按當時的地理劃分，它包含上阿姆河谷的吐火羅斯坦、扎拉夫尚河流域的粟特、下游的花剌子模，以及希薩爾山以北直到錫爾河與費爾干納的一帶。651年阿拉伯軍攻下木鹿之後，呼羅珊的邊界抵達阿姆河，此地才第一次進入哈里發國家的視野。交戰的一方是倭馬亞王朝的哈里發國家：東線由呼羅珊總督節制，673年後先後由烏拜德·阿倫·齊亞德、賽義德·本·烏斯曼、薩勒姆·本·齊亞德、庫泰巴·本·穆斯林等人輪流坐鎮。兵源分三層：從巴士拉、庫法遷來的阿拉伯部落兵，671年由齊亞德·本·阿比·蘇菲揚一次安置五萬名戰士於木鹿等呼羅珊城市；受釋的 mawla 附庸兵；以及粟特語、突厥語的本地輔兵，關鍵位置常交給粟特 dihqan 地主率領的城民兵。另一方並無單一政權，而是多股勢力的組合：布哈拉由可汗之母 khatun 攝政，幼主為突格沙達；撒馬爾罕的 ikhshid 與其粟特王公；花剌子模、烏什魯薩納等小邦；天山西部的突騎施汗國；以及以安西、北庭都護府控制塔里木的唐王朝。三方的關係時合時分，719年河中諸王甚至聯名向唐與突騎施求援。
countriesEn: Transoxiana, called in Arabic Mā warāʾ al-nahr, the land beyond the river, is the belt of oases between the Oxus and the Jaxartes where the Sogdian city-states stood. In the geography of the time it covered Tokharistan in the upper Oxus valley, Sogdia around the Zarafshan, Khwarazm on the lower Oxus, and the lands north of the Hissar range as far as the Jaxartes and the Fergana valley. Only after the Arabs took Marw in 651, pushing the frontier of the caliphate up to the Oxus, did the region come into the caliphate's view. One side was the Umayyad caliphate: the eastern line was run by the wali of Khurasan, and after 673 the post passed in turn to Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, Sa'id ibn Uthman, Salm ibn Ziyad and Qutayba ibn Muslim. The manpower came in three layers. Arab tribal soldiers, with fifty thousand warriors settled by Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan in 671 at Marw and other towns of Khurasan; mawla auxiliaries, former clients of Iranian origin; and Sogdian and Turkic native auxiliaries, with key positions often held by town militias led by Sogdian dihqans. The other side was no single state but a combination of several powers. Bukhara was run by the khatun, the queen mother, as regent for the boy Tughshada; Samarkand had its ikhshid and Sogdian princes; there were smaller polities in Khwarazm and Ushrusana; the Türgesh khaganate held the western Tian Shan; and the Tang dynasty ruled Chinese Turkestan through the Anxi and Beiting protectorates. The three sets of interests shifted between alliance and enmity, and in 719 the princes of Transoxiana even petitioned the Tang court and their Türgesh overlords for military aid.
people: 這條東線上最先成形的人物是烏拜德·阿倫·齊亞德。他與兄長齊亞德·本·阿比·蘇菲揚同為敘利亞系的呼羅珊經營者，673年秋抵達木鹿接任總督，翌春渡過阿姆河，先在拜坎一帶得手，再進逼布哈拉，迫布哈拉方面承認宗主並繳出百萬銀迪拉姆；他把二千名被俘的粟特弓手編入自己的親衛，說明這支軍隊的骨幹是射手。他之後的兩任總督各打一段：676年賽義德·本·烏斯曼打敗吉什、納薩夫、布哈拉與突厥人的聯盟，圍困撒馬爾罕三日而取之，並把四十至八十名粟特貴族帶回麥地那處決；681年薩勒姆·本·齊亞德再越河打至沙什與花剌子模，迫其繳納四十萬迪拉姆。真正改寫格局的是庫泰巴·本·穆斯林，他在705年出任呼羅珊總督，任內十年間收復巴爾赫、蕩平布哈拉的內鬥、拿下撒馬爾罕並越過錫爾河，715年渡河陣亡。粟特一方的人物同樣有名：撒馬爾罕的 ikhshid 古拉克在城破前與阿拉伯人議和，迪瓦什提奇據守穆格山要塞，後被總督賽義德·阿爾·哈拉希下令釘死在土丘上，其堡內出土的粟特文文書成為還原圍城實況的第一手材料。突騎施方面有蘇魯克與庫爾喬爾，前者722年攻入布哈拉並在峽谷之戰中擊敗阿軍，後者738年被自己的部將殺死。751年怛羅斯一役，唐方主將是安西都護府的高仙芝，阿方主將是齊亞德·本·薩利赫。
peopleEn: The first figure to shape this eastern line was Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, brother of Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan and, like him, a man of the Syrian connection in Khurasan. He reached Marw in the autumn of 673 to take up the governorship, crossed the Oxus the following spring, won a first success in the neighbourhood of Baykand, then closed on Bukhara, which acknowledged suzerainty and paid a tribute of one million silver dirhams; he enrolled two thousand captive Sogdian archers in his own guard, which shows that the backbone of this army was formed by archers. His two successors each won a season of their own. In 676 Sa'id ibn Uthman broke a coalition of Kish, Nasaf, Bukhara and the Turks, took Samarkand after a three-day siege, and carried forty to eighty Sogdian nobles back to Medina for execution. In 681 Salm ibn Ziyad raided as far as Shash and Khwarazm and levied four hundred thousand dirhams. The figure who truly reshaped the map was Qutayba ibn Muslim, appointed governor of Khurasan in 705; in ten years he recovered Balkh, broke the civil war in Bukhara, took Samarkand, drove across the Jaxartes, and was killed while crossing that river in 715. The Sogdian side has figures of its own. Ghurak, the ikhshid of Samarkand, negotiated before his city fell; Divashtich held his fortress on Mount Mugh and was crucified on a burial mound on the order of the governor Sa'id al-Harashi, and the Sogdian documents recovered from that fortress remain the first-hand source for the siege. On the Türgesh side stand Suluk and Kül Chor, the former taking Bukhara in 722 and winning the Battle of the Defile against the Arabs, the latter murdered by his own general in 738. At Talas in 751 the Tang commander was Gao Xianzhi of the Anxi protectorate and the Arab commander was Ziyad ibn Salih.
kits: 卡面這柄羅馬短劍，造於公元前100年前後，本是羅馬步兵的刺擊直刃短劍，劍身窄而厚、重心靠前，握柄可以單手揮出。到了七世紀，嚴格意義上的 gladius 早已退出現役，但短刺兵刃的傳統並未消失：東羅馬的戰略手冊仍把步兵短劍列為標準裝備，希臘文的 gladiáti 一詞仍在使用；更關鍵的是，敘利亞與美索不達米亞的新軍有大量 mawla 出身的前羅馬屬民，把羅馬式的圓盾、蒙皮鎧甲、營盤與攻城方法一併帶入哈里發國家的軍隊，之後再隨呼羅珊的將領東傳。因此這張卡代表的是「刺劍與盾緣」這一條底子：近身戰靠盾的邊緣壓住對方的兵器，再以短促的刺突解決對手，而不是靠劈砍。落到673年之後的河中戰場，雙方真正上手的仍是別的東西：阿拉伯方面是複合反曲弓（以角、筋背成的波斯式弓）、七至八世紀尚屬主流的雙刃直身鐵劍（彎度大的薩夫爾要到九至十世紀才成為標準）、長矛、以木為胎蒙皮的大圓盾，裝備則是粟特與波斯樣式的札甲（dir）與絮棉的「賈瓦克」胸甲，頭上是帶鼻樑的圓錐盔；突騎施與粟特騎兵配高鞍與馬鐙，是這支部隊在河中綠洲上來回馳援的依靠。攻城方面，阿拉伯人帶著木製可移動攻城塔（塔身覆生牛皮、頂端設跳板）、包鐵撞木、鐵鎬、火油與火箭、地道與雲梯；怛羅斯一役唐軍使用的回回炮（配重式投石機）則是中國那邊的技術。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman gladius, a short thrusting sword of about 100 BCE, narrow and heavy in the blade with the balance close to the hand so that it could be driven forward one-handed. By the seventh century the gladius in the strict sense had long left the line of service, but the tradition of the short thrusting blade did not die: Byzantine military manuals still listed the infantry shortsword as standard equipment and the Greek word gladiáti was still in use, and, more important, the armies of the new caliphate in Syria and Mesopotamia contained large numbers of mawla descended from former Roman subjects, who carried Roman-style round shields, hide-covered armour, camp discipline and siege practice into the new state, and from there east with the Khurasani commanders. This card therefore stands for the line of the stabbing sword and the shield rim: close combat is won by pressing the edge of the shield against the enemy's weapon and settling him with short thrusts, not by cutting. On the battlefield of Transoxiana after 673 the weapons actually in use were others. The Arabs carried composite reflex bows of the Persian type, with horn and sinew backing, straight double-edged iron swords that were still the norm in the seventh and eighth centuries, long spears, large wooden round shields covered in hide, and armour of the Sogdian and Persian type such as the lamellar dir and the quilted cotton jawaq cuirass, with conical helmets carrying a nasal. The Türgesh and Sogdian cavalry rode with high saddles and stirrups, and it was they who carried the campaign back and forth across the oases. For siege work the Arabs brought wooden movable towers covered in raw hide and fitted with a drawbridge, iron-headed battering rams, picks, fire and incendiary arrows, sapping tunnels and scaling ladders; at Talas the Tang fielded the counterweight trebuchet built in China.
tactics: 阿軍在東線的戰法與敘利亞基本一致，但加入了呼羅珊本地條件：出兵的季節性很強，多在河水較淺、牧草已生的春末夏初發動；渡阿姆河靠皮筏與浮橋，渡錫爾河靠舟船；兵站設在木鹿、巴爾赫等邊城，糧秣與傷患沿這條線回收。真正決定成敗的常是粟特人的嚮導與 dihqan 民兵：熟悉山道、水井與城內街道的他們，決定了襲擊能不能落到點上。攻城多為三段：先以弓手與輕騎封住城外道路，斷糧斷援；再架塔撞門、放火掘地；城破之後則拆毀城防、留下守軍、把貴族送往大馬士革或麥地那作人質。719年之後，形勢一度逆轉：突騎施與粟特反軍聯合進攻，721年庫爾喬爾在撒馬爾罕附近擊敗阿軍，724年總督穆斯林·本·賽義德在缺水中退敗，號為「口渴之日」。倭馬亞朝廷以大規模徵發回應，732年兩次遠征撒馬爾罕，737年冬在哈里斯坦擊敗蘇魯克的大軍，743年重新控制河中大部分地區。庫泰巴的做法則更細：他把本地人整編成伊朗人部隊，由哈揚·阿爾·納巴菲率領，用粟特與突厥的輔兵補主力；709年直取布哈拉成功後，把突格沙達復為布哈拉之王，在城內設軍鎮、附建清真寺，再以軍團屯駐的方式牢牢釘住河中的核心。751年怛羅斯之役，阿軍與突騎施聯軍以突厥騎兵為兩翼包抄，唐軍的糧秣與輜重在混戰中被切斷，聯鶻部倒戈，唐軍主力崩潰。
tacticsEn: The Arab way of fighting on the eastern line followed the Syrian model, with the local conditions of Khurasan folded in. Campaigns were strongly seasonal, launched in late spring and early summer when the rivers ran shallow and the grazing was up; the Oxus was crossed on rafts and pontoon bridges, the Jaxartes by boat. The base of operations lay in frontier towns such as Marw and Balkh, and grain and wounded were recovered along that line. What usually decided outcomes was Sogdian guidance and the dihqan militias: men who knew the mountain tracks, the wells and the streets inside the walls determined whether a raid landed at all. Siege work ran in three stages. Archers and light cavalry first closed the roads outside the city to cut grain and relief; then towers were raised, rams brought up, fires set and mines driven under the wall; after the city fell, the defences were dismantled, a garrison left, and the nobles sent to Damascus or Medina as hostages. After 719 the situation briefly reversed: Türgesh and Sogdian insurgents moved together, Kül Chor defeated an Arab army near Samarkand in 721, and in 724 the governor Muslim ibn Sa'id was beaten back in a shortage of water, an episode remembered as the Day of Thirst. The caliphate answered with mass levies: two expeditions against Samarkand in 732, and a victory over Suluk's great army at the Battle of Kharistan in the winter of 737, restoring control over most of Transoxiana by 743. Qutayba worked more finely. He organised the natives into Iranian corps under Hayyan al-Nabafi, using Sogdian and Turkic auxiliaries to fill the ranks of the field army. After the storming of Bukhara in 709 he re-seated Tughshada as Bukhar Khudah, built a garrison and a mosque in the citadel, and pinned the heart of Transoxiana with military colonies. At Talas in 751 the Arab-Türgesh force wrapped the Tang flanks with Turkic cavalry, cut the Chinese baggage train in the melee, and the Karluks changed sides as the Tang line collapsed.
data: 這場戰爭的規模可以從幾個可對照的數字看起。651年，呼羅珊總督阿卜杜拉·本·阿米爾攻下木鹿，邊界抵達阿姆河。671年，齊亞德一次把五萬名巴士拉、庫法軍人連家眷安置到木鹿、尼沙普爾、阿比瓦德、薩拉克斯、赫拉特等城，河中遠征的人力基礎由此成形。673年秋烏拜德·阿倫·齊亞德抵木鹿，翌春渡河，先勝於拜坎，俘二千名射手編入親衛；布哈拉方面繳出百萬銀迪拉姆。676年，賽義德·本·烏斯曼破聯盟後，圍撒馬爾罕三日取之，帶走四十、五十或八十名貴族作人質，歸途中取提爾米德，胡塔爾王出降。681年薩勒姆打到沙什與花剌子模，徵四十萬迪拉姆。705年庫泰巴收復巴爾赫；707年取努馬什卡特與拉米斯納，並擊敗費爾干納與粟特組成、號稱二十萬的聯軍；709年直取布哈拉，勒令繳納二十萬迪拉姆並設守軍；710至713年取鐵門、基什、納薩夫，於布哈拉城內建清真寺；撒馬爾罕方面，古拉克議和時留下三萬名俘虜與二百二十萬迪拉姆。715年費爾干納的伊克什迪被逐、阿拉伯扶阿魯塔爾上台，唐遣張孝嵩率一萬兵赴援，在納曼干一帶敗之。717年八月十五日，阿拉伯、吐蕃、突騎施聯軍攻阿克蘇與烏什，與唐將唐嘉會及葛邏祿阿悉那倈合力，阿方主將亞什庫里敗走塔什干。751年怛羅斯之役，兵數各家記載懸殊：漢文說唐軍一萬至十萬，阿方三萬至二十萬，較大的數字多被認為有誇大；漢文記唐軍死傷二萬至三萬，阿拉伯史料則稱斬首五萬、俘虜二萬。整場河中戰爭自673年算到751年，橫跨七十八年。
dataEn: The scale of this war can be read off a handful of comparable figures. In 651 the Khurasani governor Abd Allah ibn Amir took Marw, and the frontier reached the Oxus. In 671 Ziyad settled fifty thousand men from Basra and Kufa, with their families, in Marw, Nishapur, Abiward, Sarakhs, Herat and other towns, and that settlement became the manpower base for the Transoxianan campaigns. In the autumn of 673 Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad reached Marw; the following spring he crossed the river, won at Baykand, and enrolled two thousand captured archers in his personal guard, while Bukhara paid a million silver dirhams. In 676 Sa'id ibn Uthman broke the coalition, took Samarkand after a three-day siege, carried off forty, fifty or eighty nobles as hostages, seized Tirmidh on the way back and received the surrender of the prince of Khuttal. In 681 Salm reached Shash and Khwarazm and levied four hundred thousand dirhams. In 705 Qutayba recovered Balkh; in 707 he took Numushkat and Ramithna and defeated a coalition from Fergana and Sogdia numbering some two hundred thousand; in 709 he stormed Bukhara, imposed a tribute of two hundred thousand dirhams and installed a garrison; between 710 and 713 he took the Iron Gate, Kish and Nasaf and built a mosque in the citadel of Bukhara, while Samarkand under Ghurak's submission brought thirty thousand captives and 2,200,000 dirhams. In 715 the ikhshid of Fergana was deposed and Alutar installed, and the Tang sent ten thousand troops under Zhang Xiaosong, who defeated the Arabs at Namangan and restored the exiled ruler. On 15 August 717 Arab, Tibetan and Türgesh forces attacked Aksu and Uch Turfan and were beaten by Tang Jiahui with the Karluks under Arsila Xian, the Arab commander al-Yashkuri fleeing to Tashkent. At Talas in 751 the reported sizes diverge wildly: Chinese sources give ten thousand to a hundred thousand for the Tang and thirty thousand to two hundred thousand for the Arabs, the larger figures probably being inflated; the Chinese put Tang dead and wounded at twenty to thirty thousand, while the Arabic sources claim fifty thousand killed and twenty thousand taken captive. Counting from 673 to 751, the Transoxianan war ran for seventy-eight years.
cause: 動因是多層的。最外層是帝國競逐：西突厥汗國崩解之後，河中出現真空，粟特城邦名義上臣於突騎施，實則各自為政，唐王朝以安西都護府的名義在塔里木扶持附庸，拉住了粟特王公；哈里發國家則要在同一條街上取得對手的位置。第二層是經濟：粟特人控制絲路北線，粟特語是絲路的通用語，布哈拉與撒馬爾罕的商稅與貢賦是呼羅珊邊軍的重要收入，烏拜德一次過取走百萬迪拉姆便是明證；薩珊王朝當年限制粟特商人西行，也曾是突厥與波斯開戰的原因之一。第三層是邊防：突騎施的遊騎年年越河劫掠，綠洲城邦屢次請兵，667至670年間哈卡姆·本·阿姆爾、拉比·本·齊亞德已先後渡河打過幾輪，邊軍需要更深的推進與更強的守備。還有一層是體制層面的：齊亞德把五萬阿拉伯戰士安置在呼羅珊，等於給了遠征以常備兵源，也給了部落以劫掠與軍餉的誘因，把國家利益與個人戰利綁在一起。戰爭因此不是一次正面的帝國對決，而是一條漫長的邊疆推進線。
causeEn: The causes operated on several levels. The outermost was imperial rivalry: after the collapse of the Western Turkic khaganate a vacuum opened in Transoxiana, the Sogdian city-states were nominally subject to the Türgesh but governed themselves, and the Tang court, through the Anxi protectorate, patronised Sogdian princes in the Tarim basin, anchoring them to one side of the same corridor that the caliphate sought to control. The second layer was economic. The Sogdians ran the northern silk road, Sogdian was its lingua franca, and the customs and tribute of Bukhara and Samarkand were a material share of the Khurasani war chest, as the million dirhams taken in a single campaign show. The Sasanian obstruction of Sogdian trade to the west had itself contributed to the Göktürk-Persian wars of the sixth and seventh centuries. The third layer was frontier defence: Türgesh raiders crossed the river year after year, the oasis cities petitioned for help, and between 667 and 670 al-Hakam ibn Amr and Rabi ibn Ziyad had already led several crossings, so the frontier army needed a deeper forward line and a stronger garrison system. Underneath all of it lay a structural incentive: Ziyad's settlement of fifty thousand Arab warriors in Khurasan gave the expeditions a standing pool of manpower and tied the tribes' interest to plunder and pay, fusing state interest with private gain. This was therefore not a single set-piece contest between two empires but a long creeping frontier advance.
impact: 影響分三面寫在河中。第一，粟特城邦作為獨立的政治單元就此終結，城邦的君主、dihqan 家族與商人寡頭從獨立的統治者變成哈里發國家的附庸與被徵用的兵源；粟特語作為絲路通用語的地位，也隨着征服之後波斯語的上升而讓位。第二，伊斯蘭化來得比軍事征服慢得多，阿拉伯史料與粟特文書都顯示，廣泛改宗要到阿拔斯王朝時期才完成；在此之前，許多粟特人離開河中前往薩馬拉、哈里發巴格達、尼沙普爾與木鹿，在那裡服務並改宗，本地粟特君主則被調往哈里發身邊充當官僚。第三，軍政體制被重新砌過：木鹿、巴爾赫、布哈拉成為軍鎮，呼羅珊與河中的行政用語大量轉用波斯語，「省」與「軍區」式的劃分取代城邦聯盟，河中從此成為哈里發國家的東方邊界，向東直到帕米爾與怛羅斯，751年之後邊界再隨喀喇汗、吐蕃與唐的拉鋸而推移。第四，751年的怛羅斯之役是唐在西向擴張上的終止點：唐在西域一時失去可用之兵，755年安史之亂後再無力西顧，塔里木盆地的歸屬最終落入喀喇汗與回鶻之手。造紙術隨俘虜西傳的說法在此役後流傳甚廣，但同時代材料不足，學界多視為存疑的敘事。
impactEn: The consequences of Transoxiana can be read on three fronts. First, the Sogdian city-states ceased to exist as independent political units: their princes, dihqan families and merchant oligarchs turned from sovereigns into clients and recruited manpower of the caliphate, and the place of Sogdian as the lingua franca of the silk road was taken over by Persian as conquest settled in. Second, Islamisation came far more slowly than the military conquest; both the Arabic sources and the Sogdian documents show that mass conversion was largely a phenomenon of Abbasid times. Before that, many Sogdians left the region for Samarra, Baghdad, Nishapur and Marw, serving there and converting, while the local Sogdian rulers were moved to the caliph's court and made into officials. Third, the military and administrative order was rebuilt: Marw, Balkh and Bukhara became garrison towns, the administrative vocabulary of Khurasan and Transoxiana turned heavily to Persian, and provincial and district divisions replaced the confederation of city-states, so that Transoxiana became the eastern edge of the caliphate, running to the Pamirs and Talas, with the frontier after 751 shifting again as the Karakhanids, the Tibetans and the Tang pulled in opposite directions. Fourth, Talas in 751 marked the end of Tang westward expansion. The Tang lost the troops they could not replace in the west, and after the An Lushan rebellion of 755 they had no strength left to look west, so the fate of the Tarim basin finally passed to the Karakhanids and the Uyghurs. The story that papermaking travelled west in the captives of Talas is widely repeated, but the contemporary evidence is thin and most scholars treat it as a doubtful tradition.
result: 結局是逐步收緊的。673至681年，呼羅珊方面連續三次跨越阿姆河，取得布哈拉的宗主權與巨額貢賦，攻下撒馬爾罕，迫吉什、納薩夫、胡塔爾一帶歸順，但征服尚是零星的、由總督個人推動的推進。705年庫泰巴到任之後，節奏改變：巴爾赫、布哈拉、撒馬爾罕、費爾干納、浩吉安相繼拿下，本地伊朗人大批編入軍隊，征服由徵伐變為經營。720至738年間突騎施與粟特一度反攻，攻入布哈拉、幾度打敗阿軍，直到738年蘇魯克被部將所殺、743年河中大部分地區收復，這條線才真正穩住。751年怛羅斯之役，唐軍主力崩潰，聯鶻倒戈，唐在西向擴張就此畫上句號，這是中亞最後一場大規模阿拉伯勝利，河中全境自此在哈里發國家的控制之下，與生番的大唐、吐蕃形成新的三方邊界。此後的走向是：本地粟特君主多被調離或降為附庸，軍鎮與清真寺成為新秩序的骨架，喀喇汗於十世紀在錫爾河與費爾干納建國，把河中與喀什噶爾連成一體；而以弓為骨、以本地兵為肉、以徵賦維繫的邊軍體制，則把這條東線一直維持到中世紀盛期。
resultEn: The result tightened by degrees. Between 673 and 681 the Khurasani side crossed the Oxus three times running, took Bukhara's suzerainty and enormous tribute, captured Samarkand and brought Kish, Nasaf and Khuttal to terms, but the conquest was still a series of advances pushed by individual governors. Everything changed when Qutayba took up the governorship in 705: Balkh, Bukhara, Samarkand, Fergana and Khujand fell in turn, large numbers of native Iranians were taken into the armies, and conquest turned from raid into administration. Between 720 and 738 the Türgesh and the Sogdians rose again, took Bukhara and defeated Arab armies more than once, until Suluk was killed by his own general in 738 and most of Transoxiana was recovered by 743. At Talas in 751 the Tang main force broke, the Karluks went over, and Tang westward expansion ended: it was the last great Arab victory in Central Asia. The whole of Transoxiana passed under caliphal control, forming a new triangular frontier with Tang China and the Tibetan Empire. What followed was a new order: many local Sogdian rulers were removed or reduced to clients, garrisons and mosques became its framework, and the Karakhanid state founded in the tenth century joined Transoxiana with Kashgar. The army that held this line, bows at its core, native auxiliaries in its ranks, sustained by tribute, carried the eastern frontier well into the medieval period.
